items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1 into a CLEANER, deliberately coarser native game sprite on a strict 32 BY 32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID. The complete tool occupies only about 20 by 20 logical pixels in the same central framing and transparent margins. If output is enlarged, every logical pixel must be one equal flat square and no smaller detail pixels are allowed. Preserve this exact tool's identity, handmade construction, blade side, proportions, lower-left grip to upper-right head orientation. Remove the noisy flecks, wood-grain speckling, tiny scratches and serrated bristly outline. Simplify into large CONNECTED flat color shapes: wood is just one uninterrupted brown main face, one long warm light strip and one long dark side; NO mottling. Joint lashings are 2 or 3 broad tan crossed strips and a blocky knot holding the head securely, not a tangle of small spots. Keep wood slightly bent and head slightly asymmetrical and hand-forged. Upper-left light, 10-14 deliberate colors TOTAL, about 3 shades per material, true hard transparent alpha. Clean regular stair-step silhouette. No gradients, antialiasing, blur, dither, glitter, isolated white dots, dense texture, photorealistic 3D, background, shadow, text, hands or extra objects. Return ONE complete sprite only. Preserve the original canvas framing and tool bounding-box placement. Subject is the reference BRONZE axe. Blade must be unmistakably warm golden-brown/olive-gold bronze, visibly distinct from reddish copper and silver iron. A broad ochre main blade plane, dark olive-brown side plane and ONE short contiguous pale-gold cutting edge sheen. No green paint or dense patina dots.
